workflow: OpenAI built-in image_gen plus source-backed product composite
background_prompt: Create a clean photorealistic editorial website header background for TaraHome, 3:2 landscape, viewed straight-on in a warm contemporary residential utility room. A closed light-cream electrical service panel is mounted discreetly on the wall in the back-left, with no exposed wiring and no legible labels. In the foreground, create a broad natural-oak workbench or shallow cabinet top spanning the lower third, deliberately empty and with generous clear space for two real product cutouts to be composited later. Soft late-morning window light, warm off-white plaster, pale oak, linen texture, and one very restrained dark forest-green accent such as a small cabinet edge or distant plant pot. Practical, calm, believable homeowner setting; premium but not luxurious. Keep the center and lower foreground uncluttered. Do not depict any energy-monitor products, CT clamps, smart-home hubs, phones, tablets, screens, dashboards, open electrical panels, hands, people, tools, logos, text, labels, numbers, icons, graphs, diagrams, cables, routing lines, network paths, translucent panels, inset frames, floating UI cards, progress bars, headline poster, borders, or watermarks.
product_composite: Shelly Pro 3EM US 120A v2 official transparent product cutout
Emporia Vue 3 16-sensor official transparent product cutout without a phone or app interface
constraints: no embedded headline or title poster
no chart, graph, or generic AI diagram
no decorative routing, network, or path lines
no translucent panels, inset frames, floating UI cards, or progress bars
no exposed electrical wiring or installation instruction
warm residential materials with a restrained dark-green accent
clear and recognizable at 16:10 article and 16:9 article-card crops
